payload.sourceLineAtOldCoordinate: - [STR60] **Bug thật: `fgos return`'s working-tree-cleanliness check (`isFgosOnlyStatusLine`, `bin/fgos.mjs`/`src/runner/merge.mjs`) chỉ loại trừ status line có tiền tố `.fgos/` literal** — tìm ra qua dogfood STR59 (cell `fgos-sample-testbed-2`, 2026-07-18): khi cwd nằm trong một thư mục con của repo git thật (vd `repo/dogfood-fixture/`, không phải root), `git status` báo path theo dạng `<subdir>/.fgos/...` (tương đối với git top-level thật), không phải `.fgos/...` — nên exclusion không bao giờ khớp, và `return` liên tục từ chối "working tree not clean" dù state store của chính nó vừa tự sinh ra. Workaround đã dùng (không sửa source fgOS): commit kèm luôn các file `.fgos/*` tự sinh của fixture trong cùng commit với code change. **Mở rộng phát hiện (cell `fgos-sample-testbed-5`, item `divide`, cùng ngày):** gate này KHÔNG chỉ vướng bởi leftover `.fgos/*` — `isWorkingTreeClean` scan `git status` của TOÀN BỘ repo thật (`repo/`), không giới hạn trong cwd/subdirectory đang chạy, nên BẤT KỲ file nào khác trong `repo/` đang uncommitted (ví dụ `docs/backlog.md` do orchestrator sửa song song) cũng chặn `return` y hệt. Phạm vi bug rộng hơn ban đầu: không phải riêng `.fgos/` path-prefix, mà là toàn bộ cleanliness-check chưa cwd-scope đúng cho một fixture nằm trong subdirectory — done

payload.sourceLineAtOldCoordinate: - **Backlog done-flip fallback (D11b)** (line 81): confirm the feature's `docs/backlog.md` row flipped to `done` with a `docs/history/<feature>/` link. Scribing owns the flip at sync; when scribing legitimately NOOPed (no `behavior_change` cell), compounding is the last close point and does the flip **under the identical per-clause CoS check as scribing, never looser** (D1, decision `b9b9fee3`). Any clause without evidence → no flip; the row stays `in-flight` with a `Delivered:`/`Remaining:` annotation, and the remainder may split into a new row when the delivered subset is independently shippable. "silent full-flip on partial delivery is never allowed here either, so no shipped feature leaves a stale `in-flight` row wearing an unearned `done`." The backlog done-flip stays prose-ruled (D7); the scribing record next to it is mechanically enforced.

payload.sourceLineAtOldCoordinate: - **Four commit rules** (lines 125–128): one commit and it is the close's own commit — never fold the close into a cell's commit, never leave it for "the next commit to pick up" (per-cell commits are critical rule 7); the message names the feature and the close via `[<feature> close]` so it is findable in the log; nothing outside the close belongs in it — if `git status` shows unrelated dirty files, commit only the close's paths (`docs/history/learnings/`, `docs/knowledge/` or `docs/specs/`, `docs/backlog.md`, `.bee/`) and report the rest in the run summary; warn-never-block on a refusal you cannot resolve (hook rejects the commit, repo mid-rebase, nothing dirty because a cell already committed it) — one line in the run summary, the close proceeds. "What is never acceptable is setting the phase in §11 while silently leaving the close's artifacts uncommitted and unmentioned."

payload.sourceLineAtOldCoordinate: - **What:** New system since v1.18.3, `docs/knowledge/areas/decision-memory/overview.md` (9 business rules). Decisions carry a global content-hash `short8` id (never a small integer alone); **R8 — Citation discipline (D3):** any artifact encoding a decision cites that short8 id, which is what makes reversal reachable. **R2 — a supersede is not finished until every citing artifact is reconciled:** before its single log append, `decisions supersede` computes a citation sweep over `docs/**` (full id + word-boundary short8 match); every hit is fixed same-turn or explicitly waived with a recorded reason, and an unreconciled hit resurfaces at every flush. `decisions log --relation touches:<id>` runs the same sweep for a non-superseding reference. Free text that reads as an inline supersession claim ("supersedes", "replaces", "no longer applies"...) is refused unless a real `--relation supersedes:<id>` resolves it — a guard added after a store audit found 70 decide events hiding a supersession in prose against 29 proper supersede events. **R5 — the recall surface is a machine-regenerated index** (`docs/decisions/index.md`, never hand-edited, grouped scope→tag, superseded entries excluded, byte-stable, "complete by construction"), with structured search (`--tag`, `--scope`, `--since`, `--untagged`) — "bare substring grep is the fallback, never the recall path."
